title: Set umask for KDE Plasma via PAM
summary: Use the pam_umask module to set a consistent umask for both text console and graphical KDE sessions. This overrides /etc/login.defs and systemd settings.

steps.explain: Open /etc/pam.d/system-login with a text editor. Add or modify the line: session optional pam_umask.so umask=022. Save the file.
Log out and log back in for the changes to take effect.

rollback.explain: Remove or comment out the pam_umask.so line in /etc/pam.d/system-login.

warnings: This affects all sessions using system-login.
